articles.title: China-Botswana economic ties deepen as cooperation drives development
articles.titleCn: 中博经济纽带深化，合作驱动发展
articles.summary: In 2025, trade between China and Botswana reached $1.222 billion, up 21.3% year on year. The two countries are now expanding collaboration in trade, investment and technology, with practical projects delivering mutual benefits and injecting fresh impetus into economic and social development.
articles.summaryCn: 中国与博茨瓦纳在贸易、投资和技术等领域不断拓展合作，通过太阳能电站、水利设施和数据中心等务实项目实现互利共赢，推动博茨瓦纳经济多元化与能源转型。

paragraphs.en:
The Jwaneng solar power plant project in Botswana is built by China Harbor Engineering Company as part of a Chinese-Botswana {{0}}. /CMG
Across the vast grasslands of Jwaneng, Botswana, rows of solar panels gleam in the sunlight. The Jwaneng solar power plant, the country's first large-scale, centralized {{1}} facility with a capacity of 100 megawatts, was built by China Harbor Engineering Company as part of a Chinese-Botswana consortium. The project stands as a {{2}} example of how Chinese investment and technological expertise are supporting Botswana's energy {{3}} under the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI). In 2025, trade between China and Botswana reached $1.222 billion, up 21.3% year on year.
paragraphs.cn:
位于博茨瓦纳的朱瓦能太阳能电站项目由中国港湾工程有限责任公司作为中博联合体的一部分承建。/CMG
在博茨瓦纳朱瓦能广袤的草原上，一排排太阳能电池板在阳光下熠熠生辉。朱瓦能太阳能电站是该国首个大型集中式光伏设施，装机容量为100兆瓦，由中国港湾工程有限责任公司作为中博联合体的一部分承建。该项目是实实在在的例证，展示了在“一带一路”倡议下，中国投资和技术专长如何支持博茨瓦纳的能源转型。2025年，中博贸易额达到12.22亿美元，同比增长21.3%。

paragraphs.en:
The two countries are now expanding collaboration in trade, investment and technology, with practical projects delivering mutual benefits and injecting fresh {{4}} into economic and social development. Improving local {{5}}
Chinese-invested companies have maintained steady cooperation with Botswana for years, covering areas such as {{6}}, energy and mining, bringing tangible benefits to local communities. The Jwaneng solar power plant project officially commenced operations at the end of April 2026. The facility is expected to reduce carbon emissions by 240,000 tonnes annually, equivalent to planting two million trees, helping to ease electricity shortages and strengthen the country's energy security. Beyond its contribution to clean energy, the project team has recruited 20 recent electrical engineering graduates from Jwaneng Technical College for training, and created local employment opportunities in civil engineering, solar panel installation and electrical {{7}} during construction.
paragraphs.cn:
两国目前正在扩大贸易、投资和技术领域的合作，务实项目带来互利共赢，为经济和社会发展注入新动力。改善当地民生
中资企业多年来与博茨瓦纳保持稳定合作，涵盖基础设施、能源和采矿等领域，为当地社区带来实实在在的好处。朱瓦能太阳能电站项目于2026年4月底正式投入运营。该设施预计每年减少24万吨碳排放，相当于种植200万棵树，有助于缓解电力短缺、增强该国能源安全。除了对清洁能源的贡献外，项目团队还招募了20名来自朱瓦能技术学院的电气工程应届毕业生进行培训，并在施工期间在土木工程、太阳能电池板安装和电气调试方面创造了当地就业机会。

paragraphs.en:
Meanwhile, water infrastructure projects have played an important role in improving access to essential services across Botswana. Built by Chinese companies, the Thune Dam provides water for both domestic and agricultural use, with its water resources feeding into the country's North-South Water Carrier system. Other Chinese-supported initiatives, including water supply and {{8}} projects in Maun and the Boteti region, are also strengthening local water services and improving residents' access to clean water. New frontiers for partnership
Nowadays, cooperation between China and Botswana is increasingly extending into scientific and technological innovation and emerging industries, opening up new areas for bilateral engagement. China's 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030) identifies achieving notable progress in high-quality development as its top priority, with an emphasis on fostering new quality productive forces.
paragraphs.cn:
与此同时，水利基础设施项目在改善博茨瓦纳各地基本服务可及性方面发挥了重要作用。由中国企业承建的图内大坝为生活和农业用水提供水源，其水资源汇入该国南北输水系统。其他中方支持的项目，包括马翁和博泰蒂地区的供水和卫生项目，也在加强当地供水服务，改善居民获得清洁用水的条件。合作新前沿
如今，中博合作日益延伸到科技创新和新兴产业，为双边交往开辟了新领域。中国“十五五”规划（2026—2030年）将高质量发展取得显著进展列为首要任务，并强调培育新质生产力。

paragraphs.en: This agenda resonates with Botswana's 12th National Development Plan and Botswana Economic Transformation Programme, which seek to move the economy beyond its traditional reliance on diamonds toward {{9}} and a knowledge-based, innovation-driven model. A diamond mine in Botswana. The Digital Delta Data Center, built by China Jiangxi International Economic and Technical Cooperation Co., Ltd., is a vivid example of the two countries' growing partnership. As Botswana's first national-level data center, it provides infrastructure for large-scale data storage, processing and {{10}}, serving both government agencies and businesses. Previously, much of Botswana's government and business data was stored overseas, resulting in slower and less efficient data transfers.
paragraphs.cn: 这一议程与博茨瓦纳第十二个国家发展计划和博茨瓦纳经济转型计划相呼应，后者力求使经济摆脱对钻石的传统依赖，转向多元化和以知识为基础、创新驱动的模式。博茨瓦纳的一座钻石矿。由中国江西国际经济技术合作有限公司承建的数字三角洲数据中心是两国伙伴关系不断发展的生动例证。作为博茨瓦纳首个国家级数据中心，它为大规模数据存储、处理和传输提供基础设施，服务于政府机构和企业。此前，博茨瓦纳的大部分政府和商业数据存储在海外，导致数据传输较慢、效率较低。

paragraphs.en:
With the center now operational, more data can be stored and processed locally, enabling faster and more cost-effective data exchange and improving the online experience for users. The facility is also helping strengthen the country's information and communications technology {{11}} and lay the groundwork for the expansion of cloud services and other digital industries. Unlocking new growth opportunities
Economic and trade ties between China and Botswana are mutually beneficial and enjoy broad {{14}}. Bilateral business trips and engagements have become increasingly frequent, with continued exchange between the two sides. From May 1 this year, China extended zero-{{12}} treatment to all 53 African countries with which it has diplomatic ties, bringing significant benefits to Botswana's {{13}} products, such as beef and citrus.
paragraphs.cn:
随着该中心投入运营，更多数据可以在本地存储和处理，实现更快、更具成本效益的数据交换，并改善用户的在线体验。该设施还有助于加强该国的信息通信技术生态系统，为云服务和其他数字产业的扩展奠定基础。释放新增长机遇
中博经贸关系互利共赢，前景广阔。双边商务往来和接触日益频繁，双方持续交流。从今年5月1日起，中国对与其建交的所有53个非洲国家实施零关税待遇，为博茨瓦纳牛肉和柑橘等优质产品带来显著利益。

paragraphs.en: "This important initiative opens new opportunities for Botswana to expand its exports, strengthen trade and deepen our economic cooperation with China," said Botswana's Minister for State President, Defense and Security Moeti Mohwasa. Trade between China and Botswana rose by 58.6% to $852 million in the first half of 2026 compared with the same period last year, official statistics showed. In January 2021, the two countries signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for cooperation on the BRI, making Botswana the 46th African partner country to join the initiative. In 2025, the two countries signed a MoU on promoting the implementation of the Global Development Initiative, and Botswana joined the Initiative on International Trade and Economic Cooperation Framework for Digital Economy and Green Development. These agreements provide new opportunities and open up new prospects for China-Botswana collaboration.
paragraphs.cn: “这一重要举措为博茨瓦纳扩大出口、加强贸易和深化与中国经济合作开辟了新机遇，”博茨瓦纳总统事务、国防与安全部长莫埃蒂·莫瓦萨表示。官方统计显示，2026年上半年中博贸易额同比增长58.6%，达到8.52亿美元。2021年1月，两国签署了“一带一路”合作谅解备忘录，使博茨瓦纳成为第46个加入该倡议的非洲伙伴国。2025年，两国签署了促进全球发展倡议落实的谅解备忘录，博茨瓦纳加入了数字经济与绿色发展国际贸易和经济合作框架倡议。这些协议为中博合作提供了新机遇，开辟了新前景。

articles.fullText:
The Jwaneng solar power plant project in Botswana is built by China Harbor Engineering Company as part of a Chinese-Botswana consortium. /CMG
Across the vast grasslands of Jwaneng, Botswana, rows of solar panels gleam in the sunlight.
The Jwaneng solar power plant, the country's first large-scale, centralized photovoltaic facility with a capacity of 100 megawatts, was built by China Harbor Engineering Company as part of a Chinese-Botswana consortium.
The project stands as a tangible example of how Chinese investment and technological expertise are supporting Botswana's energy transition under the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI).
In 2025, trade between China and Botswana reached $1.222 billion, up 21.3% year on year. The two countries are now expanding collaboration in trade, investment and technology, with practical projects delivering mutual benefits and injecting fresh impetus into economic and social development.
Improving local livelihoods
Chinese-invested companies have maintained steady cooperation with Botswana for years, covering areas such as infrastructure, energy and mining, bringing tangible benefits to local communities.
The Jwaneng solar power plant project officially commenced operations at the end of April 2026. The facility is expected to reduce carbon emissions by 240,000 tonnes annually, equivalent to planting two million trees, helping to ease electricity shortages and strengthen the country's energy security.
Beyond its contribution to clean energy, the project team has recruited 20 recent electrical engineering graduates from Jwaneng Technical College for training, and created local employment opportunities in civil engineering, solar panel installation and electrical commissioning during construction.
Meanwhile, water infrastructure projects have played an important role in improving access to essential services across Botswana. Built by Chinese companies, the Thune Dam provides water for both domestic and agricultural use, with its water resources feeding into the country's North-South Water Carrier system.
Other Chinese-supported initiatives, including water supply and sanitation projects in Maun and the Boteti region, are also strengthening local water services and improving residents' access to clean water.
New frontiers for partnership
Nowadays, cooperation between China and Botswana is increasingly extending into scientific and technological innovation and emerging industries, opening up new areas for bilateral engagement.
China's 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030) identifies achieving notable progress in high-quality development as its top priority, with an emphasis on fostering new quality productive forces. This agenda resonates with Botswana's 12th National Development Plan and Botswana Economic Transformation Programme, which seek to move the economy beyond its traditional reliance on diamonds toward diversification and a knowledge-based, innovation-driven model.
A diamond mine in Botswana. 
The Digital Delta Data Center, built by China Jiangxi International Economic and Technical Cooperation Co., Ltd., is a vivid example of the two countries' growing partnership. As Botswana's first national-level data center, it provides infrastructure for large-scale data storage, processing and transmission, serving both government agencies and businesses.
Previously, much of Botswana's government and business data was stored overseas, resulting in slower and less efficient data transfers. With the center now operational, more data can be stored and processed locally, enabling faster and more cost-effective data exchange and improving the online experience for users. The facility is also helping strengthen the country's information and communications technology ecosystem and lay the groundwork for the expansion of cloud services and other digital industries.
Unlocking new growth opportunities
Economic and trade ties between China and Botswana are mutually beneficial and enjoy broad prospects. Bilateral business trips and engagements have become increasingly frequent, with continued exchange between the two sides.
From May 1 this year, China extended zero-tariff treatment to all 53 African countries with which it has diplomatic ties, bringing significant benefits to Botswana's premium products, such as beef and citrus. "This important initiative opens new opportunities for Botswana to expand its exports, strengthen trade and deepen our economic cooperation with China," said Botswana's Minister for State President, Defense and Security Moeti Mohwasa.
Trade between China and Botswana rose by 58.6% to $852 million in the first half of 2026 compared with the same period last year, official statistics showed.
In January 2021, the two countries signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for cooperation on the BRI, making Botswana the 46th African partner country to join the initiative.
In 2025, the two countries signed a MoU on promoting the implementation of the Global Development Initiative, and Botswana joined the Initiative on International Trade and Economic Cooperation Framework for Digital Economy and Green Development. These agreements provide new opportunities and open up new prospects for China-Botswana collaboration.

articles.title: Strongest super El Nino Event on record expected around November
articles.titleCn: 有记录以来最强超级厄尔尼诺事件预计11月前后出现
articles.summary: The El Nino event is continuing to develop rapidly and is expected to peak around November, potentially becoming the strongest super El Nino event since records began, according to the latest forecast by China's National Climate Center (NCC).
articles.summaryCn: 中国国家气候中心预测，2026年5月进入的厄尔尼诺状态将持续快速发展，于11月前后达到峰值，可能成为有记录以来最强超级厄尔尼诺事件，并对中国气候、农业和能源等领域产生显著影响。

paragraphs.en: Affected by a cold air mass, Wuhan experienced rainy weather with a {{0}} drop in temperature and citizens traveled in the rain, Wuhan, central China's Hubei, September 17, 2026. The El Nino event is continuing to develop rapidly and is expected to peak around November, {{1}} becoming the strongest super El Nino event since records began, according to the latest {{2}} by China's National Climate Center (NCC). The event is expected to rapidly {{3}} and come to an end in the spring and summer of 2027, while continuing to affect China's climate and key sectors including agriculture and energy, said Chao Qingchen, director of the NCC, at a press conference held by the China Meteorological Administration on Tuesday. According to NCC {{4}}, the central and eastern equatorial Pacific entered an El Nino state in May 2026. Sea surface temperature indices in the monitoring area have continued to rise rapidly since then.
paragraphs.cn: 受冷空气影响，武汉出现降雨天气，气温明显下降，市民在雨中出行。2026年9月17日，中国中部湖北省武汉。据中国国家气候中心（NCC）最新预测，厄尔尼诺事件正在持续快速发展，预计将在11月前后达到峰值，可能成为有记录以来最强的超级厄尔尼诺事件。国家气候中心主任巢清尘在周二中国气象局举行的新闻发布会上表示，该事件预计将在2027年春夏迅速减弱并结束，同时将继续影响中国气候以及农业和能源等关键领域。据国家气候中心监测，赤道中东太平洋于2026年5月进入厄尔尼诺状态。此后，监测区海表温度指数持续快速上升。

paragraphs.en:
The NCC forecasts that sea surface temperatures in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific will continue to {{5}} upward, with the index expected to peak at between 3.2 and 3.5 degrees Celsius around November, forming the strongest super El Nino event on record. Significant {{6}} on China's climate
"The rapid development of El Nino had a significant impact on China's climate during this year's flood season. {{7}} in central and eastern China generally followed a {{8}} of more rainfall in the north and south and less in the central regions, with flooding outweighing drought," Chao said. The ongoing El Nino is expected to affect the climate of China and the world in autumn and winter this year and in spring and summer next year, she said. Chao said that the impacts of a typical strong El Nino event have significant {{9}} effects and are often most {{10}} in the following year.
paragraphs.cn: 国家气候中心预测，赤道中东太平洋海表温度将继续波动上升，指数预计将在11月前后达到3.2至3.5摄氏度的峰值，形成有记录以来最强的超级厄尔尼诺事件。对中国气候的显著影响。“厄尔尼诺的快速发展对今年汛期中国气候产生了显著影响。中国中东部降水总体呈现南北多、中间少的格局，洪涝重于干旱，”巢清尘说。她表示，正在持续的厄尔尼诺预计将影响今年秋冬和明年春夏中国及全球气候。巢清尘说，典型强厄尔尼诺事件的影响具有显著滞后效应，往往在次年表现得最为明显。

paragraphs.en:
During the year when El Nino weakens, {{11}} between the ocean and atmosphere tend to strengthen the western Pacific subtropical high and continuously {{12}} warm and humid air toward China. Combined with continued global warming and the decadal strengthening of the northern rain belt, this can {{13}} to stronger and longer-lasting precipitation events and heat waves in summer. "China's climate is affected by multiple factors, including sea surface temperatures, sea ice, land snow cover and internal {{14}} in atmospheric circulation. A super El Nino event is not the sole factor affecting the climate,"Chao said. Impacts on agriculture and energy
Chao said that in the agricultural sector, attention should be paid to the possible {{15}} effects of above-average precipitation in southern China this autumn on the {{16}}, harvesting and drying of late-season rice, as well as the risk of waterlogging in farmland.

Affected by a cold air mass, Wuhan experienced rainy weather with a significant drop in temperature and citizens traveled in the rain, Wuhan, central China's Hubei, September 17, 2026. 
The El Nino event is continuing to develop rapidly and is expected to peak around November, potentially becoming the strongest super El Nino event since records began, according to the latest forecast by China's National Climate Center (NCC).
The event is expected to rapidly weaken and come to an end in the spring and summer of 2027, while continuing to affect China's climate and key sectors including agriculture and energy, said Chao Qingchen, director of the NCC, at a press conference held by the China Meteorological Administration on Tuesday.
According to NCC monitoring, the central and eastern equatorial Pacific entered an El Nino state in May 2026. Sea surface temperature indices in the monitoring area have continued to rise rapidly since then.
The NCC forecasts that sea surface temperatures in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific will continue to fluctuate upward, with the index expected to peak at between 3.2 and 3.5 degrees Celsius around November, forming the strongest super El Nino event on record.
Significant impacts on China's climate
"The rapid development of El Nino had a significant impact on China's climate during this year's flood season. Precipitation in central and eastern China generally followed a pattern of more rainfall in the north and south and less in the central regions, with flooding outweighing drought," Chao said.
The ongoing El Nino is expected to affect the climate of China and the world in autumn and winter this year and in spring and summer next year, she said.
Chao said that the impacts of a typical strong El Nino event have significant lag effects and are often most pronounced in the following year.
During the year when El Nino weakens, interactions between the ocean and atmosphere tend to strengthen the western Pacific subtropical high and continuously transport warm and humid air toward China. Combined with continued global warming and the decadal strengthening of the northern rain belt, this can contribute to stronger and longer-lasting precipitation events and heat waves in summer.
"China's climate is affected by multiple factors, including sea surface temperatures, sea ice, land snow cover and internal variability in atmospheric circulation. A super El Nino event is not the sole factor affecting the climate,"Chao said.
Impacts on agriculture and energy
Chao said that in the agricultural sector, attention should be paid to the possible adverse effects of above-average precipitation in southern China this autumn on the maturation, harvesting and drying of late-season rice, as well as the risk of waterlogging in farmland.
In the spring and summer of next year, attention should be paid to the potential adverse effects of persistent rainfall on crops including rice and rapeseed.
In the energy sector, Chao recommended monitoring the impact of intermittent strong cold waves this winter on heating demand in northern China, as well as the impact of widespread high temperatures next summer on air-conditioning loads and peak electricity demand.

articles.fullText:
China is ready to work with New Zealand to tap the potential of trade in services and expand cooperation in sectors such as new energy vehicles, photovoltaics and wind power, Chinese Premier Li Qiang said on Monday during a phone conversation with New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon.
China-New Zealand relations have maintained steady and sound momentum, with new progress made in cooperation across various fields, Li said.
Meanwhile, the international situation remains complex and evolving, with unilateralism and protectionism continuing to weigh on the global economy, he said, adding that calls from the international community to safeguard the multilateral system and strengthen openness and cooperation are growing louder.
As supporters and practitioners of multilateralism and free trade, China and New Zealand should strengthen communication and coordination, Li said.
Noting that the two countries will mark the 55th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations next year, Li said China stands ready to work with New Zealand to carry forward their traditional friendship, expand mutually beneficial cooperation and deepen their comprehensive strategic partnership, injecting fresh impetus into the stability, development and prosperity in both countries, the region and the world.
Li said China is willing to work with New Zealand to remain partners that respect each other and pursue mutual benefit and win-win cooperation.
He called on both sides to continue to expand the scale and improve the quality of bilateral trade in goods, tap the potential of trade in services and expand cooperation in areas such as new energy vehicles, photovoltaics and wind power to deliver more tangible results.
The premier expressed hope that the two sides will accelerate negotiations on a negative list for trade in services under the China-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement and achieve substantive progress at an early date.
The two countries should facilitate people-to-people exchanges and deepen exchanges and cooperation in culture, tourism, education, young people and sub-national entities to strengthen the foundation of friendship between their peoples, Li said.
As members of the Asia-Pacific family, China and New Zealand should also strengthen cooperation within the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) framework and actively advance the building of an Asia-Pacific community, he added.
For his part, Luxon said New Zealand-China relations are developing steadily, with practical cooperation advancing across various fields and benefiting the peoples of both countries.
New Zealand attaches great importance to its relationship with China and remains firmly committed to the one-China policy, he said.
New Zealand is willing to take the opportunity of next year's 55th anniversary of diplomatic relations to strengthen high-level exchanges with China, deepen mutual understanding and trust, and enhance practical cooperation in trade, tourism, new energy and other areas to advance the comprehensive strategic partnership, he said.

The 2026 National Day holiday film season in China surpassed 100 million yuan (about $14.9 million) in box office revenue on its first day, with several domestic films competing for moviegoers. Meanwhile, cinemas across the country are exploring new ways to attract visitors by expanding beyond traditional film screenings.
Children watch a science film with their parents at a cinema in Jiaxing, Zhejiang Province, September 13, 2026. 
From live sports broadcasts and cultural activities to tourism, retail and other lifestyle experiences, cinemas are becoming more than just places to watch movies.
One of the latest developments is bringing major sporting events to cinema screens. During the holiday period, a cinema livestreaming program launched by Huaxia Film partnered with more than 100 cinemas across China to broadcast the 2026 China Open tennis tournament on the big screen. It was the first time Huaxia Film had brought a top-tier tennis event to cinema screens.
For sports fans, watching matches in a cinema offers a different experience from that at home. Participating Huaxia cinemas use high-frame-rate LED screens and immersive sound systems to capture fast-moving details, such as ball trajectories and spins, while recreating the atmosphere of live competition. The program also broadcasts matches featuring Chinese tennis player Zheng Qinwen, as well as the men's and women's singles semifinals and finals.
Beyond sports, cinemas are also linking movie consumption with tourism, culture and local services.
In south China's Guangdong Province, some cinemas have partnered with tourism companies to launch travel packages connected with movie tickets. In east China's Zhejiang Province, moviegoers can use ticket stubs to access benefits from thousands of businesses, including tourist attractions, restaurants, retail and other services.
Across China, cinemas are also hosting a variety of cultural activities during the holiday. They include intangible cultural heritage displays, craft workshops, music performances, themed markets and interactive exhibitions. In some cities, film-related markets and interactive events are encouraging moviegoers to spend more time in cinema venues beyond the screening itself.
The trend reflects a broader shift in China's cinema industry. As audiences seek more diverse entertainment options, theaters are expanding their role from film screening venues to comprehensive cultural spaces that combine entertainment, social interaction and cultural experiences.
By connecting movies with sports, culture, tourism and everyday life, cinemas are creating new ways for audiences to engage with the big screen.

2026年中国国庆档电影季首日票房突破1亿元（约合1490万美元），多部国产影片争相吸引观众。与此同时，全国各地的影院正在探索新方式，通过拓展传统电影放映之外的业务来吸引客流。2026年9月13日，孩子们和父母在浙江省嘉兴市一家影院观看科普电影。从体育赛事直播、文化活动到旅游、零售及其他生活方式体验，影院正变得不仅仅是看电影的地方。最新的发展之一是将重大体育赛事搬上影院银幕。假期期间，华夏电影推出的一项影院直播计划与全国100多家影院合作，在大银幕上转播2026年中国网球公开赛。

这是华夏电影首次将顶级网球赛事搬上影院银幕。对于体育迷来说，在影院观看比赛与在家观看有着不同的体验。参与合作的华夏影院采用高帧率LED屏幕和沉浸式音响系统，捕捉球的轨迹和旋转等高速运动细节，同时重现现场比赛的氛围。该计划还转播中国网球选手郑钦文的比赛，以及男女单打半决赛和决赛。除了体育之外，影院还将电影消费与旅游、文化和本地服务联系起来。在广东省，一些影院与旅游公司合作，推出了与电影票关联的旅游套餐。

在浙江省，观众可以凭电影票根享受数千家商家的优惠，包括旅游景点、餐厅、零售及其他服务。在全国各地，影院在假期期间还举办各种文化活动，包括非物质文化遗产展示、手工坊、音乐表演、主题市集和互动展览。在一些城市，与电影相关的市集和互动活动鼓励观众在放映之外在影院场所停留更长时间。这一趋势反映了中国电影行业更广泛的转变。随着观众寻求更多元化的娱乐选择，影院的角色正从电影放映场所扩展为集娱乐、社交和文化体验于一体的综合文化空间。

通过将电影与体育、文化、旅游和日常生活相连接，影院正在为观众创造与大银幕互动的新方式。

articles.fullText:
The Kirin 9050 Pro, launched inside the Mate 90 series on Thursday, is one of the first commercial processors built on LogicFolding – an architecture Huawei unveiled in May as the practical core of its "Tau Scaling Law." The company positions it as a successor to Moore's Law, as transistor shrinks approach physical and economic limits.
Instead of shrinking transistors, LogicFolding stacks two active circuit layers and links them with millions of vertical interconnects, shortening the distance signals must travel between logic blocks.
That answers a constraint Huawei consumer chief Richard Yu acknowledged days before the launch: "Advanced semiconductor capacity remains very limited in China," where chipmakers still depend on deep ultraviolet lithography rather than the extreme ultraviolet tools used at the leading edge.
Yu framed it in a single line: "Moore's Law pursues smaller transistors; Tau's Law pursues shorter, faster signal paths." CGTN previously described the approach as a move "from geometry to time," optimizing signal delay instead of transistor density.
The results are substantial. The Kirin 9050 Pro carries 5 million signal bonding points and delivers 125 TB/s of inter-die bandwidth. Huawei claims a 31% performance gain over the previous flagship generation, with critical-path latency cut by more than 30% – a figure that matters more for sustained workloads than peak benchmarks.
The trade-off is wafer consumption. LogicFolding needs more silicon area per chip than a conventional planar design, and stacking layers adds manufacturing steps that reduce yield. That caveat lands against Yu's own admission that advanced capacity is already stretched thin, with Huawei's Ascend AI accelerators competing for the same limited wafer supply as its smartphone chips.
Whether LogicFolding scales beyond a single flagship – or remains a costly workaround for one product line – will depend less on the architecture than on how much advanced capacity China can create.
